title: Men's Golf – I Play Army Golf Hoodie

seo.title: Golf Hoodie for Dad: Funny I Play Army Golf Hoodie
seo.description: A funny golf hoodie for dad: a retro golfer mid-swing, LEFT. RIGHT. LEFT. I PLAY ARMY GOLF. Printed to order, free US shipping on $45+.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This golf hoodie for dad is for the weekend golfer whose ball goes left, right, left and who still holds the follow-through like a pro, and it makes a funny gift any time it turns cold.

A 1970s golfer in a visor and plaid flares finishes his swing while the ball's dotted path zigzags between pine stands on both sides. LEFT. RIGHT. LEFT. runs across the top in burnt orange slab letters and I PLAY ARMY GOLF. closes the print in dark green, both lines at full width.

Pull it on for early tee times, the cart path and the clubhouse patio. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Sport Grey
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

What colors does it come in?
The Men's Golf I Play Army Golf hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. comes in Sand and Sport Grey. The burnt orange LEFT. RIGHT. LEFT. line, the dark green I PLAY ARMY GOLF. line and the brown linework all read clearly on both light blanks, so every word stays easy to read on the course.

Is it a good gift for a golfer?
Yes. The Men's Golf I Play Army Golf hoodie gives a golfer a joke his whole foursome will recognize, on an 8 oz 50/50 fleece that is warm for early tee times. Graphic Tees Co. prints it to order; order by about December 8 for Christmas delivery with free US shipping over $45.

How does the I Play Army Golf hoodie fit?
The Graphic Tees Co. I Play Army Golf hoodie is a classic unisex pullover cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one size for a roomier fit over a polo or quarter-zip on a cold morning round.

How do I care for it?
Machine wash this Graphic Tees Co. hoodie cold, inside out, with similar colors, then tumble dry low. The 8 oz 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece is pre-shrunk, and washing inside out keeps the orange and green print and the pine scene looking sharp season after season.

What does army golf mean?
Army golf is golf slang for a ball that goes left, right, left, like marching cadence. The Graphic Tees Co. hoodie carries the joke on the chest with the zigzag ball path in the art. There is no uniform or insignia, just the golfer's swing and a dry punchline.
